source.notes: ISC Class XI school quarterly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Quarterly Examination 2018-2019', 'PHYSICS', 'Class - XI', 'Time : 3Hrs.+15mints.', 'Full Marks : 70'; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h + 15 min as printed (the 15 min is probably reading time). The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); it is a booklet imposition with two printed pages per PDF page (PDF 1 = printed p.1 with a blank p.8; PDF 2 = pp.2 and 7; PDF 3 = pp.6 and 3; PDF 4 = pp.4 and 5); `page` is the PDF page. Text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against page images rendered at higher scale. Section A has no printed question number (entered as number 1): (A) five 1-mark MCQs [1x5=], (B) seven 1-mark short answers [1x7]. Sections B (Q2–Q7, 2 marks), C (Q8–Q17, 3 marks) and D (Q18–Q21, 5 marks) print marks only on some questions; unprinted marks were taken from the other questions of the same section (flagged per question). By these section values the paper adds up to 74 against the printed Full Marks 70 (the printed paper itself is inconsistent); with internal OR choices each alternative is its own entry (labels (a)/(b) assigned by the editor), so the pack's marks total is higher. Figures not reproduced: Q7 graph (PDF p.3), Q11 OR pulley blocks (PDF p.4), Q20 incline/pulley diagram (PDF p.2). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
